blockers.detail: No provider/container scheduler, durable-volume provisioning, TLS ingress or secret-file mount renderer exists in this Terraform planner. Linkable descriptors are not deployed infrastructure.

Native gateway TraceItem producer targets authenticated loopback tail ingress and durable local capture. Existing Cloudflare workers need a separate authenticated export attachment; no native binary is usable as a Cloudflare tail_consumer. Honeycomb uploads remain disabled as in baseline.
